activity_summary: You came down well and sat at her table. The loaf was a finger short of the notch and still a penny. Firing is sixpence the week, and she did not take it at breakfast. The Shrew at two was not yours, and Ranger's Comedy was the Rose bill. You stayed in. The letter stayed unanswered. You meant to try one line and stop.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came down well, ate, and did not go out.
